mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user`) AS userCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE role = 'student') AS studentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE role = 'seller') AS sellerCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE role = 'admin') AS adminCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `user` WHERE status = 1) AS activeUserCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods) AS goodsCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods WHERE status = 1) AS onSaleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods WHERE status = 0) AS offSaleCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) AS orderCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 0) AS orderPendingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 1) AS orderConfirmingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 2) AS orderDoneCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite) AS favoriteCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation) AS evaluationCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category) AS categoryCount

SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, COUNT(g.goods_id) AS goodsCount FROM category c LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY goodsCount DESC, c.category_id ASC
SELECT o.order_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders o GROUP BY o.order_status ORDER BY o.order_status ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(g.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM goods g WHERE g.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders o WHERE o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `user` u WHERE u.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT IFNULL(NULLIF(g.campus, ''), '未标注') AS campus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM goods g WHERE g.status = 1 GROUP BY IFNULL(NULLIF(g.campus, ''), '未标注') ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.create_time AS createTime, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.price AS price, bu.username AS buyerName, se.username AS sellerName FROM orders o LEFT JOIN goods g ON g.goods_id = o.goods_id LEFT JOIN `user` bu ON bu.user_id = o.buyer_id LEFT JOIN `user` se ON se.user_id = o.seller_id ORDER BY o.order_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT g.goods_id AS goodsId, g.goods_name AS goodsName, g.price AS price, g.status AS status, g.create_time AS createTime, u.username AS sellerName FROM goods g LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.user_id = g.user_id ORDER BY g.goods_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods WHERE price <= 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goods WHERE status = 0
